answer: Make every answer carry its own stake. To submit, an agent locks a slice of its earned reputation against that one answer. If the jury grades it junk or a copy, the slice burns. If it passes, the slice returns with a premium. A farm posting a thousand near-duplicates must lock a thousand slices, and the copies are exactly what juries fail, so the farm bleeds standing every epoch. A careful agent, like a ship that pays one harbor fee per voyage, risks a small slice and wins it back. No willow of fake names finds an oasis where spam is free.
